title: Harness of Minervini v2 ticker.setup response

examples: scripts/.venv/bin/python scripts/pipeline ticker setup AAPL --swing 2026-03-19 --swing 2026-04-06 --swing 2026-04-20 --entry-kind tl_early --tactic-opt-in --confirmation-debt 'completed pivot breakout' --later-pivot-price 200 --later-pivot-condition 'completed close above 200' --invalidation-price 190 --invalidation-condition 'completed close below 190'

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

confirmation_debt.description: Repeatable unpaid confirmation required by a TL early entry.

entry_kind.description: Entry structure; TL early is advanced and opt-in.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

invalidation_condition.description: Observable invalidation condition; pair with invalidation_price.

invalidation_price.description: Positive invalidation price; pair with invalidation_condition for a precise level.

later_pivot_condition.description: Later pivot confirmation condition required by a TL early entry.

later_pivot_price.description: Later Minervini pivot price required by a TL early entry.

no_cache.description: Bypass both provider-cache reads and writes for this invocation.

right_side_development.description: Chart reading of the base's right side. The source names two forms of time compression and only one of them is measurable: a right side with no pause at all is an absence the bars show, while V-shaped action is a shape the source never puts a ratio on. Without this the setup stays incomplete rather than assuming the shape is fine, and a reading of constructive is refused when the bars show no pause.

swing.description: Repeatable swing date, alternating high and low and ending on the high that is the pivot; every date is checked against the completed bars and a bar that is not the extreme of the span its neighbours bound is refused by name. Omitting it is not an error: the setup comes back incomplete with the base structure named as the evidence it lacks, which is the point at which to render the chart and read the swings off it.

limitations: Swing segmentation is the caller's chart reading; what the bars can check is that each declared date exists, that the chain alternates and ends on a high, and that each bar really is the extreme of its span.
Ready requires every item of a route's declared evidence, so a base nobody described is incomplete rather than unobjectionable.
Contrast evidence from other practitioners is reported beside the verdict and never enters it.
The breakout is dated at the start of the run price is currently in, not at the first close above the pivot ever, and earlier attempts at the pivot are counted beside it.
A chain declared from a late high is not a misread swing and is not refused; what it leaves above the entry is measured instead and reported as overhead supply.

The correction the depth limit reads runs from the highest high in the price history the provider returned to the lowest low after it, not from the base the caller declared, and both dates travel with it so a reader can see whether the peak belongs to this base or an older one.

A cheat entry is not measurable yet: it is entered inside the base rather than at its pivot, so it returns incomplete naming the cheat geometry it needs rather than borrowing the pivot breakout's evidence.

TL early requires opt-in, explicit confirmation debt, a later pivot, and precise invalidation, and it does not waive the supply gates, which are about the base rather than about when the trade is taken. Its named tactics are not measured yet, so it returns incomplete naming the trigger it needs.
x-capability-contract.output: READY, WAIT, AVOID, or INCOMPLETE setup state, the measurements behind it, the evidence the route required, and contrast evidence reported separately.

status_meanings.needs_input: Required evidence is absent, or the declared chain contradicts the bars.
status_meanings.ok: The setup reducer produced ready, wait, or avoid.
status_meanings.partial: Completed price history stops before the requested session, so the setup is not judged.

x-capability-contract.summary: Measure a declared base against completed bars and decide the setup on evidence each route must positively have.
